body:
This PR contains several miscellaneous updates to the system, with two notable changes:

1. The size of the CPU KV cache is now calculated based on the `swap_space` size provided by the user (defaulting to 20 GiB).

body:

The changes in this PR eliminate the need for redundant data movements such as `torch.cat`, `torch.stack`, and `torch.contiguous`, which were previously used to align input and output shapes. title: [BugFix] Fix NaN errors in paged attention kernel (#936)
linked_issues: #641 RuntimeError: probability tensor contains either `inf`, `nan` or element < 0
body:
Fixes #641 
This PR fixes the paged attention kernel. Currently, the kernel computes `attn_weight * value` for all tokens in a value block, even if some of them are not included in the context. It is generally acceptable since the `attn_weight` for those tokens is 0, but this causes errors when the tokens contain NaNs (since 0 * NaN is NaN). The PR solves this by explicitly setting the values of those tokens as 0.

This PR adds a new Intel GPU(also named `XPU` in pytorch context) backend to vLLM and supports the basic model inference feature, with FP16 type support.

Added VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE ENV to specify backend explicitly.

title: Correct alignment in the seq_len diagram. (#5592)
body: This PR corrects a minor formatting issue in the documentation for context_len, query_len, and seq_len. There is seemingly an extra dash in the `seq_len` line, causing a slight misalignment in the diagram. This misalignment could potentially confuse users trying to understand the definitions.

title: [Hardware][TPU] Support parallel sampling & Swapping (#5855)
body:
This PR adds parallel sampling and swapping support for the TPU backend.

~~**NOTE:** Swapping is not implemented for the TPU backend yet. Therefore, vLLM will raise an error if OOM happens during parallel sampling.~~
